trigger: I am being stopped from travelling within Nigeria
description: What to do if you are prevented from moving freely within the country.

steps.text: Stay calm and ask why you are being stopped.
You have a right to move freely throughout Nigeria and to reside anywhere in it (s.41).
Ask on what specific legal authority your movement is being restricted.
Do not offer money to be allowed to pass.
Note the officers' names, numbers, the location and time.
If your right is being denied unlawfully, keep a record for a complaint.
Call a lawyer or trusted person if you are detained.

citations.source_name: 1999 Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria
